title: Curds and Whey
selectSource: Pick a card to move (a column top, or a same-suit descending run). Double-click to auto-move it to the best column
noAutoMove: No column available to move to

tutorial.columns: Thirteen tableau columns. Move a top card or a same-suit descending run onto a card of the SAME SUIT one rank higher, or of the SAME RANK, or into an empty column.
tutorial.rules: A complete King-to-Ace same-suit run is removed automatically. Clear all four suits to win. There is no stock.

frontendHint.curdsandwheyMove: Cards in this column can move to another
